sources.title: Widget2Code: From Visual Widgets to UI Code via Multimodal LLMs
sources.snippet: We formalize the Widget-to-Code (Widget2Code) task and introduce the first image-only widget dataset with fine-grained, render-level evaluation metrics. We benchmark existing UI2Code models and show that specialized methods underperform general-purpose MLLMs on widgets, exposing key challenges in visual grounding and structural reconstruction.
